mapper.sql: id, msg_id, server_msg_id, src_id, dest_terminal_id, msg_content, msg_fmt, service_id, channel_code, status, status_report, error_msg, signature, carrier, create_time, update_time, status_report_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ink_sms_down WHERE dest_terminal_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR src_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR msg_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR channel_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ink_sms_down WHERE dest_terminal_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR src_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR msg_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR channel_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT d.id, d.msg_id, d.server_msg_id, d.sp_id, d.src_id, d.dest_terminal_id, d.msg_content, d.msg_fmt, d.service_id, d.channel_code, d.status, d.status_report, d.error_msg, d.signature, d.carrier, d.fee, d.create_time, d.update_time, d.status_report_time, c.name AS channel_name, c.host AS channel_host, c.port AS channel_port, c.status AS channel_status FROM ink_sms_down d LEFT JOIN ink_channel c ON c.code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = d.channel_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE d.id = #{id}
